question: Who among the following won the ‘ICC Spirit of Cricket Award of the Decade’ in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Dhoni.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MS Dhoni** has won the** ICC Spirit of Cricket Award **of the Decade following a fan vote for his decision to recall Ian Bell after a controversial run out in the 2011 Nottingham Test between England and India.
 
• He is among the **most successful captains in world cricket.**
 
• It was under his leadership that India lifted the **ICC Cricket World Cup in 2011** after having led India to triumph in the ICC World T20 in its maiden edition held in 2007 in South Africa. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Cricket Council (ICC)**:

 
 
• ​**Headquarter** - Dubai (UAE)
 
• **CEO** - Manu Sawhney
